step1_analysis.description: A series stack of two PMOS transistors sharing a common gate input. In the context of the paper's substrate noise measurements, this likely forms part of a digital noise generator or a pull-up network of a logic gate.

paper_reference.title: Simulation and Measurement of Supply and Substrate Noise in Mixed-Signal ICs

Vout_DC.description: DC voltage at the intermediate OUTPUT node when the input is biased at mid-supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: With N8=1.8V and N4=0V, the two identical PMOS transistors act as a voltage divider. Ignoring body effect differences, the output should be approximately VDD/2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric W/L (5u/0.5u) and identical gate bias (0.9V) lead to equal channel resistances.

Power_DC.description: Static power consumption of the PMOS stack when both transistors are partially ON.

sky130_expected.calculation: Rds_on ≈ 1 / (up*Cox * W/L * (Vsg - |Vth|)). up*Cox=50uA/V^2, W/L=10, Vsg=0.9V, |Vth|=0.42V. Rds_on ≈ 1 / (50u * 10 * 0.48) ≈ 4.1 kOhm. Total R ≈ 8.2 kOhm. Power = V^2 / R = 1.8^2 / 8.2k ≈ 395 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on first-order square-law model for SKY130 PMOS devices.

Gain_AC.description: Small-signal AC voltage gain from INPUT to OUTPUT at 1 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Since both transistors are driven by the same input and act as a divider, the small-signal gain is determined by the ratio of their transconductances and output conductances. It is expected to be an attenuator (negative dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The circuit is not a standard amplifier; it's a stack where both devices modulate simultaneously, leading to low or negative gain.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, AC gain, and transient response of the PMOS stack.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PMOS Stack Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 N4 INPUT OUTPUT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUTPUT INPUT N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Supply and Bias Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN8 N8 0 1.8
VN4 N4 0 0
VINPUT INPUT 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)

* Load to prevent floating nodes if both PMOS turn off
Rload OUTPUT 0 1MEG

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let vout_dc = v(OUTPUT)
let power_dc = -i(VVDD) * 1.8 - i(VN8) * 1.8
print vout_dc
print power_dc

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 10 1k 100MEG
let gain_db = vdb(OUTPUT)
meas ac gain_1mhz find gain_db at=1MEG

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 10n 5u
meas tran vout_max max v(OUTPUT)
meas tran vout_min min v(OUTPUT)
let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
print vout_pp

quit
.endc
.end
